lista.respuesta: A way to take control of your health. Kuova brings together how you feel, the data from your watch or ring and your lab results; it explains what they mean and suggests a plan to improve. Then you measure again to see what worked.

No. Kuova does not diagnose: it gives you clear information to understand your health and to share with a healthcare professional if you wish. Clinical assessment and any medical decision always belong to a professional.
At a lab near you, in a single visit. We're working on letting you collect your sample from home too: we'll let you know as soon as it's available.

lista.pregunta: Can I use lab results I already have?
lista.respuesta: Yes. Upload the PDF or a photo and the app extracts the results for you. You review them before saving and they become part of your history.
Watches and rings that sync with Health Connect on Android, for example from Garmin, Samsung, Xiaomi, Oura or Google. Apple Health is coming soon. We only read the data you allow.
It is stored in the European Union with restricted access. We never sell it or use it for advertising, and only the people you authorise can see it.
